decisions.reason: Featured on the home page and close to the core craft offer, this illuminated arch reflects a visible commitment that management will justify and maintain.
A one-tier pyramid is central to the firm's traditional identity and was prominently showcased, so management persists with it.

Although distant from the core, the electronic music box was showcased on the home page as a new direction, and its development investment encourages persistence by attributing weak results to market introduction time.
As an accessory tied to the music box platform the firm has committed to, it is kept to support that system, though its low visibility makes it more expendable.
The Christmas motif platform links the new music box line to the firm's seasonal core, which helps justify the earlier investment and keeps it on the market.
The Dresden-themed pyramid builds directly on the established offer and was visibly promoted, making retention very likely.
